items.source: Delegates to processEvent(ApplicationEvent) to give subclasses a chance to deviate from the default. Unwraps the content of a PayloadApplicationEvent if necessary to allow a method declaration to define any arbitrary event type. If a condition is defined, it is evaluated prior to invoking the underlying method.
items.translation: 委托给processEvent(ApplicationEvent)，以便子类有机会偏离默认行为。如有必要，会解包PayloadApplicationEvent的内容，以允许方法声明定义任意事件类型。如果定义了条件，则在调用底层方法之前对其进行评估。

items.source: Matches the condition attribute of the EventListener annotation or any matching attribute on a composed annotation that is meta-annotated with @EventListener.
items.translation: 匹配 `EventListener` 注解的`condition`属性，或匹配任何由带有 `@EventListener` 元注解的组合注解上的相应属性。

items.source: The default implementation returns Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE`。

items.source: These arguments will be used to invoke the method handled by this instance. Can return null to indicate that no suitable arguments could be resolved and therefore the method should not be invoked at all for the specified event.
items.translation: 这些参数将用于调用此实例处理的方法。可以返回 `null` 以表示无法解析合适的参数，因此不应为指定的事件调用该方法。

items.source: The default value is an empty String.
items.translation: 默认值为空字符串。

items.source: The default implementation builds a method name with parameter types.
items.translation: 默认实现使用参数类型构建方法名。
